ticker_news.title: Egnyte Joins the Pax8 Marketplace
ticker_news.description: Egnyte has been added to the Pax8 Marketplace, enabling over 40,000 Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to access its AI-powered secure collaboration platform with hybrid cloud capabilities and Microsoft integrations.
ticker_news.author: Stan Hansen

ticker_news.title: Buckle Up: Why Wednesday Could Be the Craziest Trading Day of the Year
ticker_news.description: A pivotal Wednesday featuring the Federal Reserve's rate decision and earnings reports from major tech companies Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta is expected to create significant market volatility, with potential impacts on interest rates and tech sector performance.
ticker_news.author: Jesse Cohen

ticker_news.title: Microsoft Earnings Preview: AI Infrastructure and Capital Efficiency in Spotlight
ticker_news.description: Microsoft is preparing to report Q1 earnings, with significant focus on Azure cloud services, AI infrastructure investments, and the recent OpenAI partnership that includes a $250 billion Azure services commitment.
ticker_news.author: Ali Merchant

ticker_news.title: Microsoft's New OpenAI Deal Could Be Its Smartest AI Move Yet
ticker_news.description: Microsoft strengthened its partnership with OpenAI, securing a 27% stake and a $250 billion Azure compute services commitment, which analysts view as a strategic move to solidify its AI infrastructure leadership.
ticker_news.author: Akanksha Bakshi

ticker_news.title: Fed Rate Falls Below 4% for First Time Since 2022, Markets See More Cuts Ahead
ticker_news.description: The Federal Reserve lowered interest rates by 25 basis points to the 3.75-4.00% range, marking the first time in three years the federal funds rate has been below 4%. Markets anticipate potential additional rate cuts, with 84% of traders expecting another cut in December.
ticker_news.author: Valuewalk

ticker_news.title: Vanguard's VOOG and VONG ETFs Offer Distinct Paths to Growth
ticker_news.description: Vanguard offers two growth-oriented ETFs, VOOG and VONG, which track different indices but provide low-cost access to large-cap U.S. growth stocks with similar expense ratios and performance characteristics.
ticker_news.author: Howard Smith
